actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident4 gave >30 in last round, so punish with max affordable severity (6). Broadcast discouragement.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow rules. Latest round 7 just happened. We are Resident2, wallet 2.04. Check most recent round contributions: round 7 contributions_by_agent shows Resident4 contributed 48.15 (>30). So rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with max severity affordable = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet 2.04, punishment_cost 0.3 => floor(2.04/0.3)= floor(6.8)=6 severity. Can punish Resident4 (target). Severity 6 costs 6*0.3=1.8, affordable. So action punish Resident4 amount 6. Also we can broadcast a short discouraging message. Must include at most one physical and one communication. So include punish and broadcast. Output JSON.

Explanation brief.
